sources.observation: Seven pointed bays use cobalt and turquoise panels and a deep central recess. Pale stone forms a low base.

sources.credit: Hero Farnam, see linked file for license
sources.observation: The circular brick tower has turquoise geometric inlays and cobalt friezes beneath the curved brick dome.

limitations: Roof heights and the inner court basin and plantings are estimated from reference photos. The glazed geometric motifs are simplified. The model covers the exterior shrine and garden enclosure. The independently mapped cemetery and museums remain host features.
